request.purpose: We decide which applicants for life insurance we decline, based on how common this disease is in their age group and region.
request.question: How many adults with asthma does each hospital hold?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45.
Report per hospital: adults with asthma.
